classification: preregistered synthetic crop-model-v2 one-day root-zone capacity variant; not a crop or soil benchmark
status: Independently reviewed preregistration; candidate not executed. Exact-head CI is still required before candidate test execution. A-05 and 02A remain UNVERIFIED.

review.S2: APPROVE: arithmetic, assertions, and the <=1e-12 mm arithmetic-only tolerance. Notes that zero ET does not test ordering when transpiration and drainage are both positive; preregistration review only, candidate not executed.
review.S3: No findings; no scope overclaim identified. Preregistration review only, candidate not executed.

sourceContext.citation: Allen et al. (1998), Crop Evapotranspiration: Guidelines for Computing Crop Water Requirements, FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Chapter 8, Eqs. 82, 85, 86, and 88.
sourceContext.sourceVersion: FAO-56 (1998), Chapter 8; official HTML chapter page
sourceContext.artifactStatus: Official chapter HTML retrieved 2026-10-27; 137909 bytes. No source artifact copied or committed.
sourceContext.licenseOrReuse: No reuse license found on the source page; no source artifact copied or committed. Only FAO-56 equations are referenced; AWC 1.0 mm/cm remains a synthetic software input, not a source-derived soil value, default, or soil/media profile.
sourceContext.reuseLimit: The FAO-56 equation references are reused from the parent positive-drainage fixture. AWC 1.0 mm/cm is an explicit synthetic software input, not a source-derived soil value, default, or soil/media profile.

parentFixture.reuseLimit: Keep the parent crop, thermal, production, root-depth, route, and one-day weather forcing. Change only frozen soil AWC from 2 to 1.0 mm/cm; derive capacity and starting storage from the same 80 cm fixed depth and 0.99375 initial storage fraction.

frozenModelInputs.soilSourceTag: unknown; AWC is a synthetic software input and not a sourced or observed soil profile
frozenModelInputs.climateRoute: Standard open-field crop-model-v2 root-step path; no environment snapshot and no environment-v2 climate model.

soil.sourceStatus: Synthetic software input only; not a soil/media default, source value, or observed profile.

rootZone.method: FAO-56 root-zone balance as integrated by crop-model-v2
rootZone.rootDevelopment: none; no runtime rootDevelopment parameter is supplied, so effective root depth is fixed at 80 cm
rootZone.runoffAndInfiltrationBoundary: All 5 mm precipitation is treated as root-zone inflow and runoff is fixed at 0 for this synthetic software boundary.

dailyEnvironment.weatherStatus: One-day synthetic forcing retained from the parent fixture; light and temperature are ancillary to this water-balance check.

expected.equations: Capacity = AWC × fixed effective root depth. Initial storage = capacity × initialStorageFraction. With ETc, runoff, irrigation, capillary rise, and root-growth storage all zero, drainage = max(0, initial storage + precipitation - capacity); final storage = min(capacity, initial storage + precipitation); residual = initial storage + inflows - runoff - drainage - actual ETc - final storage.

directRootZoneStep.depletionFractionAssertion: Strict equality with fao56AdjustedDepletionFraction(0.4, 0); mathematical expected p=0.6; no tolerance and no frozen runtime binary representation.

integratedRoute.route: One-cell standard open-field crop-model-v2 createRun/stepDay/simulateRun path; no environment-v2.
integratedRoute.createRunState: Assert exact cell rootZoneWaterMm=79.5 and capacity=80 mm before stepDay; no root-depth state or root-growth inflow.
integratedRoute.stepDayCallObservation: Observe exactly one actual stepFao56RootZone call through a call-through observer that invokes the original reducer. Assert state.waterMm=79.5; params.awcMmPerCm=1.0; effectiveRootDepthCm=80; depletionFraction strictly equals fao56AdjustedDepletionFraction(0.4, 0); fluxes.precipMm=5; irrigationMm=0; runoffMm=0; capillaryRiseMm omitted/undefined and defaulted to zero; rootGrowthStorageMm=0; potentialTranspirationMm=0. Install after the direct-helper assertion and restore in finally before simulateRun.
integratedRoute.stepDayOutputs: Assert exact effective precipitation=5 mm and unrounded waterUseMm=0; assert final rootZoneWaterMm=80 mm and defined accumulated/max residuals=0. Integrated drainage is inferred by mass balance and is not a persisted daily output.
integratedRoute.simulateRunOutputs: Assert one simulated day, summary rainMm=5 and waterUseMm=0, final rootZoneWaterMm=80, and defined zero root-zone residual summaries. Mass balance implies integrated drainage=4.5 mm.

tolerances.waterArithmetic: Absolute deviation <=1e-12 mm for direct root-step drainage/storage/depletion/residual arithmetic and integrated mass-balance drainage inference; double-precision arithmetic only.
tolerances.exactChecks: Frozen input values, one-cell/one-day count, fixed 80 cm depth, no environment-v2 route, exact createRun pre-step state and capacity, exactly one observed call with all frozen state/parameter/flux values, strict depletionFraction equality with the frozen helper expression and no tolerance, and exact final reducer state/summary fields.
tolerances.scope: Arithmetic-only bound; not a soil-parameter uncertainty, source-display, model-error, biological-validation, measured-agreement, or prediction tolerance.

limitations: AWC 1.0 mm/cm is not a soil/media default, a sourced soil value, or an observed profile.
This fixture does not validate soil hydraulics, infiltration, crop biology, or soilless/media behavior.
Zero ET means ordering when transpiration and drainage are simultaneously positive is untested.
The fixture is synthetic software evidence only; no crop, measured, source-trajectory, or prediction claim is made.
acceptanceOwner: A-05 simulator acceptance owner; independent S2 and S3 review required.
acceptanceStatus: S2 approved arithmetic/assertions/tolerance and S3 found no findings; candidate not executed; exact-head CI is still required before candidate test execution.
